change.runtime: CellUi::new keeps the caller's explicit PaintStyle as its default padding/reset style. The additive padding_style builder allows a composing Grid to pass a canonical style without reading painted buffer cells or reconstructing semantic roles.
change.grid: For ordinary active values only (no action affordance), vacated aligned callback cells use ui.surface_style().patch(row_style): missing row channels retain the resolved UI surface while authored row channels win. Action cells keep their existing full active style. Explicit CELL patches still run after callback rendering.
change.compatibility: Explicit caller Danger and Color::Reset padding remain honored; no public PaintStyle fields changed.

red_before_green_after.native_regression: termrock-grid::grid::tests::identity_cell_callback_preserves_right_aligned_padding_style compares the ordinary renderer and an identity callback at every color level without a focused-row override or post-render dim.
